findings.finding: Registered supply that can be sold on any night, including tonight: a $200m universal F-3 shelf, effective 2026-09-11, from an issuer that has raised repeatedly (IPO 2025-03, a 424B4 offering 2025-11-28, a best-efforts unit offering with zero-price-exercise warrants closed 2026-07-08), plus an S-8 effective 2026-09-11 registering 5,087,548 pre-split Class A shares (about 203k post-split, about 20% of the 1.02m Class A outstanding) under the 2026 plan. FPI status means sales by award holders would not show up on Form 4.
findings.mechanism_in_window: Both registrations are effective now, so a shelf takedown (registered direct via a 424B) can price tonight, and S-8 shares can be sold in the 2026-09-25 session. Nothing dates either one to this window, so this is sized as a small per-night probability times a large impact, not as an expected event.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The 2026-06-08 F-1 filing coincides with the baseline's 2026-06-08 fall of -37.56%, followed by +19.92% the next close. There has been no shelf takedown before, because this is the issuer's first F-3. The July 2026 offering priced units at $0.79 pre-split with warrants exercisable at zero price for two shares.
findings.source_date: 2026-08-14 (F-3 filed); EFFECT accepted 2026-09-11 04:15 UTC; S-8 https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2018529/000121390026099064/ea0303538-s8_intercont.htm filed 2026-09-11
findings.why_not_priced: The overhang has been public for two weeks and the price reflects its existence, but not a draw on it. The float test uses the highest price in the last 60 days, and the pre-collapse price puts the float near $90m on the issuer's own 2026-08-12 figure, so the baby-shelf cap may not bind. If a takedown were priced in, the stock would sit at a visible discount to a deal price. A deal priced tonight would print as a gap of tens of percent.
findings.independence: The 2026-09-07 subscription agreement shows the company raising cash through the CEO (1,625,000 Class B at $0.40 pre-split, $650k), which points to cash need: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2018529/000121390026099320/ea0305176-6k_intercont.htm. The same document also shows the CEO paying the equivalent of about $10 post-split, above spot, which cuts the other way.

outside_window.finding: 180-day lock-up on officers, directors and certain holders from the 2026-07-08 unit offering closing ends about 2027-01-04. That is dated supply, but it lands months after the window.

Warrants from the July 2026 offering (8m pre-split, zero-price option for two shares each, about 640k shares post-split if unexercised) are exercisable until about six months after issuance. Undated supply.
Stock trades far below the reported book value of $20.28 a share. Cheapness is not a mechanism.
